summary.en: Sort balanced halves and merge their fronts stably using a shared linear buffer.
summary.bn: দুই ভাগ আলাদা করে সাজিয়ে সামনে থাকা ছোট মানগুলো নিয়ে merge করো।

notes: C17 baseline; general algorithm bounds treat input size as variable.

examples.title: Order five marks, including a tie
examples.explanationHtml: Balanced calls produce sorted halves [3,7] and [1,3,5]. Their final merge yields 1 3 3 5 7.

examples.title: Sort numbers entered at the keyboard
examples.explanationHtml: The merge buffer carries negative values normally. Left-on-equality preserves the repeated -2 records.

examples.title: Use sorted neighbours to find distinct marks
examples.explanationHtml: After recursive merging, the five marks form groups for 1, 3 and 5. Their group count is three.

examples.title: Merge labelled halves stably
examples.explanationHtml: Left-on-equality produces 1A before 1C and 3B before 3D. Tail copying retains each half record without overwriting unread input.

practice.title: Count marks below a threshold after merging
practice.statementHtml: Order n marks using merge sort, then count those strictly below a threshold. Display Enter n, then n values: before n (0..64) and the marks (-99..99), followed by Enter threshold: before an integer threshold. Report below = C; marks equal to the threshold are excluded.
hints: After merging, all qualifying marks form one prefix.

practice.title: Report the ordered middle mark
practice.statementHtml: Use buffered merge sort to order n marks. Begin with Enter n, then n values:, then accept n = 0..64 and values -99..99. Print middle = V using the lower middle for an even length; print No middle for no values.
hints: The lower middle zero-based index is (n - 1) / 2.

practice.title: Explain the Merge Sort invariant
practice.statementHtml: For Merge Sort, state what stays true as the main process repeats. Explain the start, preservation and completed result.
hints: Use the changing boundaries and the processed region in this method.
practice.answerHtml:
For the merge loop, temp[low..k) is sorted and contains exactly the consumed prefixes of the two halves. Its last value is no larger than either next available front. Choosing the smaller front extends this invariant, and copying a remaining tail preserves it after one half becomes empty.

For the recursive algorithm, induct on interval length. Lengths below two are already sorted. Both shorter halves are sorted by the induction hypothesis. The merge lemma then gives a sorted permutation of their union. Because each recursive interval is shorter, recursion reaches the base and terminates.

practice.title: Derive the resource cost of Merge Sort
practice.statementHtml: Show the merge work per recursion level and count the shared buffer and active frames.
hints: Count the work from this algorithm rather than naming a class alone.
practice.answerHtml: A single merge performs at most m - 1 cross-half comparisons for m positive total elements when both halves are nonempty. Some arrangements exhaust a half earlier, but every value is still emitted and copied. This explains the Θ(m) local cost even when comparison counts vary. Across the tree, balanced height gives Θ(n log n) time and the one shared output buffer gives Θ(n) auxiliary space.

practice.title: Reconstruct the small merge sort trace
practice.statementHtml: Merge-sort [7,3,5,3,1] using half-open intervals and left-on-equality. Show each completed merge and the final sorted halves.
hints: Record state before changing another boundary or moving the next value.
practice.answerHtml:
StageStateReason
Merge [0,2)[3,7,5,3,1]The left pair is ordered.
Merge [3,5)[3,7,5,1,3]The right pair is ordered.
Merge [2,5)[3,7,1,3,5]The right three-value half is ordered.
Merge [0,5)[1,3,3,5,7]Choose the smaller front until both halves finish.

quiz.prompt: For merge_sort on [low,high), which base condition is correct?
quiz.explanation: Empty and singleton intervals need no merge.

quiz.prompt: Why does merging need only the two front values?
options: All left values are globally smaller
quiz.explanation: No later value in a half can precede its own front.

quiz.prompt: Which equality rule makes buffered merge sort stable?
quiz.explanation: Earlier equal records must stay before later equal records.

quiz.prompt: What remains after one merge half is exhausted?
options: An already ordered tail to copy
quiz.explanation: The other half retains its internal order.

quiz.prompt: What is the standard balanced merge recurrence?
quiz.explanation: Two half sorts plus one linear merge describe the work.

quiz.prompt: Why is the shared merge buffer linear rather than quadratic?
options: The recursion makes one call total
The same n-cell storage is reused across calls
Every call has no local variables
The array stores only one bit
quiz.explanation: Recursive intervals write different ranges of the shared buffer.

quiz.prompt: For the shown merge sort, what happens on already ascending input?
options: It still performs balanced splitting and merges
It always returns after one comparison
quiz.explanation: No boundary-check optimisation is present in this implementation.

quiz.prompt: Which side is chosen when stable merge fronts both equal 3?
quiz.explanation: Choosing left preserves the earlier record on equality.

quiz.prompt: Where does [0,5) split under the merge midpoint rule?
quiz.explanation: The halves have lengths two and three.

quiz.prompt: How many records are copied from a three-value leftover tail?
quiz.explanation: The remaining half interval [2,5) contains three records.

keyPoints.en: Sort both halves before merging them.
keyPoints.bn: দুই অর্ধেক সাজানোর পর merge করো।

keyPoints.en: The smaller front is the next output value.
keyPoints.bn: সামনের দুই মানের ছোটটিই পরের আউটপুট।

keyPoints.en: Copy the leftover tail after one half ends.
keyPoints.bn: এক পাশ শেষ হলে অন্য পাশের বাকি মান কপি করো।

keyPoints.en: Choose the left record on equality for stability.
keyPoints.bn: সমান হলে বামের record আগে নিলে stability থাকে।

keyPoints.en: A shared buffer needs linear auxiliary space.
keyPoints.bn: একটি shared buffer-এ linear বাড়তি জায়গা লাগে।

keyPoints.en: Balanced levels yield n log n work.
keyPoints.bn: সমানুপাতিক ভাগের স্তরগুলো মিলিয়ে n log n কাজ হয়।
